COMMIT.summary: Commits the current transaction and applies all changes.

oneOf.description: RETURNING committed-version. The version at which the transaction was committed. -1 if the transaction contained no mutations.
RETURNING versionstamp. The 10-byte versionstamp assigned to the transaction.

arguments.name: returning
arguments.summary: Requests a value from the committed transaction. Case-insensitive.

arguments.name: committed-version
arguments.summary: Return the committed version as an integer.

arguments.name: versionstamp
arguments.summary: Return the versionstamp as a bulk string. The transaction must have performed at least one mutation.
